tools.name: list_components
tools.title: List components
tools.description: Returns the Originkit component index from the registry. Use this to discover available components or find the right one for a request. Optionally filter by category (hero, navbar, pricing, cards, forms, animation, data). When signed in, also includes your saved section variants as `@me/<slug>`.

tools.name: get_component
tools.title: Get component
tools.description: Returns the source code for a Originkit component, adapted to the caller's stack. Pass `stack`, `styling`, and `typescript` so the right variant is served (Framer source as-authored, or plain React / Next.js with Framer bindings removed). `preset` selects a named install preset (same as CLI `originkit add <name> --<preset>`). `tweaks` (a map of prop -> value) overrides props and wins over preset; when both omitted, the component's default preview configuration is delivered. For a saved playground section, pass `name` as `@me/<slug>` (requires sign-in) — returns the section plus its Originkit dependency tree. Presets apply to components only.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search components
tools.description: Search the Originkit component library by keyword. Returns matching components with a citation URL for each. Use `fetch` with a returned id to read a component's full details and source.

tools.name: fetch
tools.title: Fetch component
tools.description: Fetch the full details and ready-to-use source for a single Originkit component by id (its slug, as returned by `search`). Returns the component's description and Next.js-ready code with a citation URL.
